pages.title: Christoffel Symbol
pages.text: A record of how coordinates twist from point to point on a curved space. It is not a tensor, but it tells you how vectors change as you carry them along. The symbol looks slightly different each time you turn it.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Differentiating geodesic threads with a Koch crystal's self-similarity, I tracked how coordinates bent near the horizon. The Chrono Loom produced the connection coefficients.
Made in $(item)Chrono Loom$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inside a Black Hole.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Stress-Energy Tensor, Unified Notes II.
